reviews.t: Fits a kid's head better than adult
reviews.x: I bought this for my 5 year old daughter to be Wednesday Addams and it fits her really well (it's a tad big but it does the job). I tried it on my head and like other reviewers said, it's too small for the average adult's head. You could see a good inch of my back of my head. If you are buying for a child it's perfect, if you are looking for one for an adult I would not recommend it.

There are exactly two uses for this product: Wednesday Addams Pocahontas  Naturally, this means that the purest expression of this product would be Wednesday Addams dressed as Pocahontas.  This, melding of wig-usage was, of course, actually a key aspect of the 1993 Barry Sonnenfeld film, Addams Family Values.  I won't spoil the ending but.. not only can you be both Wednesday Addams AND Pocahontas, I would dare say you SHOULD be both Wednesday Addams and Pocahontas.

The quality of the wig fibers wasn't bad, but it was so small I had to look the package over to make sure I hadn't ordered a child's wig by mistake. It's possible my head could maybe be larger than average, but this was so small that it just sat on top of my head like a beanie; nowhere close to covering it.  I returned it and found another one through one of those seasonal Halloween shops that crop up every year and that one fit perfectly.

reviews.t: While the product is good for color and braids
reviews.x: While the product is good for color and braids, it is way too small for most adults. I couldn't position it to cover the back of my hair and hairline for the life of me, even with a wig cap. I had to double check it wasn't a child's wig! If it was just longer in the back it would've been perfect.

reviews.t: I expected it to look better than it did
reviews.x: While I know it's a costume wig, the part and top of the wig were jacked. One side was higher than the other. You get what you pay for, however, I expected it to look better than it did.
Definitely sized for a child. Purchased this for my 8 year old daughter and it barely fit her head. I wouldn’t recommend this wig if you’re an adult.
Definitely sized for a child. Purchased this for my 8 year old daughter and it barely fit her head. I wouldn’t recommend this wig if you’re an adult.

reviews.t: WAY too small -- wouldn't even fit onto my reasonably small head.
reviews.x: Uh, no. I couldn't even get it to cover the TOP of my scalp - it just sat on top of my head.
This wig was way too small, poorly constructed, and a major disappointment.

reviews.t: I have never worn a wig before so maybe I ...
reviews.x: I have never worn a wig before so maybe I was just doing it wrong, but it didn't really seem to fit my head. I couldn't really get it to hide all of my hair. It worked for my Wednesday Addams costume, but I wish it were a little bigger on the skull area. Maybe I have a big head.

reviews.t: Small and had a side part
reviews.x: The wig did the job for our costume but expected a little more. The wig was quite small, even on a child’s head (an 8 year old girl) and the part on the wig style, was not down the center, as pictured, it had a side part. The wig was however, well made, black and shiny!

I purchased this wig for my daughters Wednesday Addams costume.  The wig is very small.  My daughter is 10 years old and average size and the wig barely fit.  Def would not fit teenagers or adults.  But if its for a kid it is a great wig at a great price.

It was perfect for my Wednesday Addams costume!  Unfortunately, it was a bit itchy and got worse throughout the day.  However, if you're wearing it like I did for Halloween, you can deal with it.  I'd recommend it!
The wig is okay for the price, but definitely on the small side. I have an average to small head and I couldn't even get my medium length hair tucked under it and it was still tight.
It definitely runs small, it was the perfect size for my 9 year old daughter. Not heavy, it was comfortable.
I haven't actually used yet.  I did try it on.  It fits well and looked as I imagined it would.

reviews.t: Gretlat for my kids Wednesday Adam's costume.
reviews.x: My kid loved it but it only lasted a few days which is to be expected.
looks good, maybe a little tighter for a normal sized head.

reviews.t: Fits too small, not good quality
reviews.x: At first glance, I thought the wig looked great. Upon closer inspection, there were hairs throughout the entire wig that weren’t full length. There were short ones, like one inch long, that were mixed in. I thought it’d be ok, but after wearing only two times for less than an hour each time, those short hairs began being more noticeable. They didn’t stay in place and you could tell it wasn’t quality. Also, my daughter is 7 and very petite. The wig didn’t fully cover her hairline. If it covered i

This wig was inexpensive and will be used once for Halloween. So I am not too picky about the quality. It is small, just barely fits my 8 year old’s head, which is good because it’s snug and will stay put. It was folded flat in packaging but not along the part, so one side of the head has a big lump. I’m guessing a little shaping will help and maybe some time in a steamy bathroom. The braids are loose and long. On my8 year old, they come down to about 2 inches below her natural waist. I removed

reviews.t: I think we got a faulty one
reviews.x: It was creased really badly about an inch away from the part line. The whole top of the wig to the back of the head. Also the inseam stitching was hanging out on my daughter forehead. It was maybe packaged poorly. Cause the hair looked really shiny and black, but with all the creases and defects of our wig we had to return it.

reviews.t: Works great for my Wednesday costume
reviews.x: The wig fit just fine for me, and I'm an adult. Using it for a Wednesday Adam's costume. Shiney, but think I even had a bun in my hair no wig cap and there isent any of my own hair showing. Not sure if they've fixed it since all the other bad reviews but it will work just fine for my costume! Good deal for the price

Bought for my daughter for her Wednesday costume. Looked nice, but it lasted for photos that’s it because it was very itchy she said. When we took it off we had to agree. Very stiff and hard plastic mesh under it. She has fairly thin hair that only goes to her shoulders and it was hard to fit it inside the wig.

The wig was a little small for a normal adult head. Luckily my hair is the same color so you couldn’t tell in the back that it didn’t cover my hair all the way. The braids were completely uneven. One was longer than the other and I had to cut them to get them to the same length.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: There are random short pieces and the lengths on each pony tail don’t match up. I’m going to try some leave in conditioner and brushing them out and rebraiding and trimming to see if I can fix it up. I got it on Wednesday and need it for Saturday so I don’t have time to return.

claims.text: The wig runs very small and is sized for children, fitting poorly or not at all on most adults.
It works well for kids' Wednesday Addams costumes, fitting children around ages 5 to 10.
The color and braids look good and the wig is well made for the price.
Some reviewers found the construction or styling flawed, such as an uneven top or a side part instead of the pictured center part.
It can be itchy or uncomfortable to wear for extended periods.
